The **1957 Soviet Cup** (Кубок СССР по футболу 1957) was the **17th edition** of the Soviet football cup competition, held during the 1957 season. Here’s everything I know about it:

---

### **Overview**
- **Full Name:** Кубок СССР по футболу 1957 (USSR Cup 1957)
- **Organizer:** Football Federation of the USSR (Федерация футбола СССР)
- **Format:** Knockout tournament (single-elimination)
- **Participants:** Teams from the **Soviet Top League (Class A)**, **Class B**, and some lower-division teams.
- **Final:** Held on **October 26, 1957**, at the **Central Lenin Stadium (Luzhniki, Moscow)**.
- **Winner:** **Lokomotiv Moscow** (their **2nd Soviet Cup title**).
- **Runner-up:** **Spartak Moscow**.

---

### **Key Details**
#### **1. Tournament Structure**
- The competition followed a **single-elimination** format, with matches decided by extra time and (if necessary) replays.
- **Seeding:** Higher-division teams entered in later rounds.
- **Replays:** If a match ended in a draw after extra time, a replay was held (no penalty shootouts existed at the time).

#### **2. Notable Matches & Upsets**
- **Early Rounds:**
  - Many lower-division teams (from **Class B**) competed, with some causing upsets.
  - **Shakhtar Stalino (Class A)** was eliminated early by **Avangard Kharkov (Class B)**.
  - **Zenit Leningrad (Class A)** lost to **Torpedo Gorky (Class B)** in the Round of 32.

- **Quarterfinals:**
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** defeated **CSKA Moscow** (1-0) in a tightly contested match.
  - **Spartak Moscow** beat **Dynamo Kiev** (2-1) in a high-scoring game.

- **Semifinals:**
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** vs. **Dynamo Moscow** – **Lokomotiv won 1-0** (goal by **Valentin Bubukin**).
  - **Spartak Moscow** vs. **Torpedo Moscow** – **Spartak won 3-1** (hat-trick by **Nikita Simonyan**).

#### **3. The Final (October 26, 1957)**
- **Venue:** **Central Lenin Stadium (Luzhniki, Moscow)** – capacity ~100,000.
- **Attendance:** ~103,000 (one of the highest attendances for a Soviet Cup final).
- **Teams:**
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** (managed by **Boris Arkadiev**)
  - **Spartak Moscow** (managed by **Nikolai Gulyayev**)
- **Match Summary:**
  - **0-0 after 90 minutes** (despite several chances for both teams).
  - **Extra time:** **Lokomotiv’s Valentin Bubukin** scored the **winning goal in the 97th minute**, securing a **1-0 victory**.
  - **Key Moments:**
    - Spartak dominated possession but struggled to break down Lokomotiv’s defense.
    - Lokomotiv’s goalkeeper **Vladimir Maslachenko** made several crucial saves.
    - Bubukin’s goal came from a counterattack after Spartak lost the ball in midfield.

- **Lineups:**
  | **Lokomotiv Moscow** | **Spartak Moscow** |
  |----------------------|--------------------|
  | Maslachenko (GK)     | Ikoniya (GK)       |
  | Ryzhkin              | Tishchenko         |
  | Sokolov              | Maslenkin          |
  | Bubukin              | Netto (C)          |
  | Artemev              | Paramonov          |
  | Lashin               | Isayev             |
  | Sokolov              | Ilyin              |
  | Voroshilov           | Simonyan           |
  | Sokolov              | Salnikov           |
  | Sokolov              | Tatushin           |
  | Sokolov              | Mosharkin          |

- **Man of the Match:** **Valentin Bubukin** (scored the winner).

---

### **4. Winners & Awards**
- **Champion:** **Lokomotiv Moscow** (2nd Soviet Cup title, after 1936).
- **Top Scorer of the Tournament:** **Nikita Simonyan (Spartak Moscow)** – **5 goals** (including a hat-trick in the semifinal).
- **Best Player:** **Valentin Bubukin (Lokomotiv)** – scored the winning goal in the final.

---

### **5. Historical Context**
- **Lokomotiv’s Triumph:**
  - This was **Lokomotiv’s first major trophy since 1936** (when they won the first Soviet Cup).
  - The victory was significant as **Spartak Moscow** was the dominant team of the era (they had won the **1956 Soviet Top League** and would win it again in **1958**).
  - **Boris Arkadiev**, Lokomotiv’s manager, was a legendary Soviet coach who had previously led **CSKA Moscow** to multiple titles.

- **Spartak’s Disappointment:**
  - Spartak was the favorite, having won the **1956 league title** and being one of the strongest teams in the USSR.
  - Their loss in the final was a major upset, especially since they had **Nikita Simonyan**, one of the greatest Soviet strikers of all time.

- **Impact on Soviet Football:**
  - The 1957 Cup was part of a **transition period** in Soviet football, with **Dynamo Kiev** and **Spartak Moscow** emerging as powerhouses.
  - **Lokomotiv’s victory** showed that smaller clubs could still compete with the giants.

---

### **6. Other Notable Facts**
- **First Use of Floodlights in a Soviet Cup Final:**
  - The match was played under **artificial lighting** (a rarity at the time), making it one of the first major Soviet games to use floodlights.
- **Political Undertones:**
  - The Soviet Cup was often seen as a **symbol of national unity**, with teams from different republics (Russia, Ukraine, Georgia, etc.) competing.
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** was associated with the **railway workers’ union**, while **Spartak** was linked to the **trade unions** (a rivalry with political connotations).
- **Legacy:**
  - This was the **last Soviet Cup final** before the **1958 season**, which saw **Spartak Moscow** win the **double (league + cup)**.
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** would not win another Soviet Cup until **1996** (after the USSR’s dissolution).

---

### **7. Full Tournament Bracket (Key Matches)**
*(Note: Some early-round results are incomplete due to limited records.)*

| **Round**       | **Match**                          | **Score**       |
|-----------------|------------------------------------|-----------------|
| **Round of 32** | Zenit Leningrad vs. Torpedo Gorky  | 0-1             |
| **Round of 16** | Lokomotiv Moscow vs. Dinamo Tbilisi| 2-1             |
| **Quarterfinal**| Lokomotiv Moscow vs. CSKA Moscow   | 1-0             |
| **Quarterfinal**| Spartak Moscow vs. Dynamo Kiev     | 2-1             |
| **Semifinal**   | Lokomotiv Moscow vs. Dynamo Moscow | 1-0             |
| **Semifinal**   | Spartak Moscow vs. Torpedo Moscow  | 3-1             |
| **Final**       | Lokomotiv Moscow vs. Spartak Moscow| 1-0 (a.e.t.)    |

---

### **8. Sources & References**
- **Soviet Football Archives** (RSSSF – Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation)
- **"History of Soviet Football"** by **Aleksei Lebedev**
- **Newspaper reports** from *Sovetsky Sport* (1957)
- **Lokomotiv Moscow & Spartak Moscow club archives**

---

### **9. Why Was This Cup Significant?**
- **First major trophy for Lokomotiv in 21 years** (since 1936).
- **Proved that underdogs could beat the giants** (Spartak, Dynamo, CSKA).
- **Marked the rise of new stars** like **Valentin Bubukin** and **Nikita Simonyan**.
- **Set the stage for the 1958 season**, where Spartak would dominate.
